device_gpu_auto_description: Recommended: Automatically select the best hardware renderer based on your system setup.
device_gpu_host_description: Force Hardware: Offload all 3D rendering tasks directly to your graphics card (dGPU/iGPU).
device_gpu_software_description: Software Mode: Uses your CPU for graphics. Very slow, use only as a backup.
device_quick_boot_description: Resume instantly from your last saved state (turn off for full cold boot).
device_boot_animation_description: Display the native Android logo animation during startup.
device_ultra_gaming_description: Load disk writes directly into physical RAM. Instant loads and zero stutter. Note: Discards gameplay updates/cache on shutdown.
device_speed_mode_description: Automatically disables system UI animations and forces GPU composition in SurfaceFlinger on boot for maximum gaming frame rates.
device_missing_images: No system images installed! Go to SDK Manager and install at least one system image (phone, TV, etc.) first.
device_special_create_description: Wear OS, Android TV, and Automotive emulators use native default configurations. Custom settings (RAM, Cores, Resolution, GPU, DPI, Storage) are managed automatically by the system.
device_special_edit_description: Wear OS, Android TV, and Automotive emulators use native default configurations. Custom settings (RAM, Cores, Resolution, GPU, DPI) are managed automatically by the system.
device_x86_tip: x86_64 images run natively on your PC. GPU mode host passes your GPU directly to the emulator for maximum performance.
device_delete_warning: This will permanently erase all data, apps, and storage associated with this emulator.
device_wipe_warning: This will completely wipe all user accounts, installed apps, settings, and files.
device_wear_detected: Wear OS Watch detected! Resources are limited to 1 GB of RAM and 2 CPU cores, and the circular screen layout is preserved.
device_tv_detected: Android TV detected! Resources are limited to 2 GB of RAM and 2 CPU cores.
device_automotive_detected: Android Automotive detected! Resources are limited to 4 GB of RAM and 4 CPU cores.
device_delete_question: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?
device_wipe_question: Are you sure you want to factory reset {{name}}?
device_auto_gpu_hint: Auto Mode is recommended. It selects your dedicated card ({{gpu}}) and uses DirectX translation on integrated GPUs.

This will remove the system files from your disk. Any created devices using this image won't be able to boot until reinstalled.

sdk_core_missing: Download the core emulator tools to create and run virtual devices.
sdk_loading: Fetching latest package manifests from Google APIs...
sdk_no_matches_hint: Try clicking "Sync Repo" or clearing your search filter.
gpu_preference_applied: GPU preference applied! Emulator will use selected GPU on next launch.
gpu_registry_admin_required: Some registry entries may need administrator rights.
gpu_whpx_enabled: WHPX enabled — please restart your PC.
gpu_preference_fast_description: Use dedicated GPU — maximum gaming performance
gpu_preference_default_description: Let Windows decide which GPU to use
gpu_accel_whpx_description: Best performance. Fully compatible with WSL2, Hyper-V, Docker, and VirtualBox.
gpu_accel_aehd_description: Google's lightweight standalone driver. Works on Intel/AMD. (Must disable Hyper-V to run AEHD).
gpu_accel_haxm_description: Intel's hardware acceleration driver. Works on Intel CPUs only (Deprecated).
gpu_accel_off_description: Extremely slow! Emulates CPU in software. Use only for diagnostic troubleshooting.
gpu_render_host_description: Direct access to your selected graphics card. Best for 3D gaming.
gpu_render_angle_description: Translates OpenGL calls into Windows DirectX. Highly stable.
gpu_render_swiftshader_description: CPU-rendered graphics. Slow, compatibility mode only.
gpu_tip_host: Use GPU mode "Host" when creating a device — passes graphics directly to your GPU with zero translation overhead.
gpu_tip_x86: Always use x86_64 system images — no ARM emulation overhead, runs at native CPU speed.
gpu_tip_resources: Allocate at least 4 CPU cores and 4 GB RAM for gaming apps.
gpu_tip_whpx: Enable WHPX (Windows Hypervisor Platform) for CPU virtualization — massive speed improvement.
gpu_tip_snapshot: Use fast boot (snapshot) to avoid waiting for Android to cold boot each time.
gpu_tip_close_apps: Close other GPU-heavy apps while gaming in the emulator for best frame rates.
gpu_camera_description: Disables front/back virtual cameras. Bypasses 3D scene rendering for faster startup.
gpu_gps_description: Stops the emulator from continuously tracking your computer's location.
gpu_bluetooth_description: Disables the background Bluetooth network daemon (netsimd), saving ~100MB of RAM.
gpu_no_devices: No GPUs detected. Check your GPU drivers.
gpu_scan_description: Hardware configuration is cached. Use rescan if you made hardware changes.
gpu_accel_description: Choose which CPU virtualization driver to use when launching emulators.
gpu_whpx_disabled: WHPX is selected but not enabled in Windows.
gpu_render_description: Select the graphics acceleration mode passed to the emulator on startup.
gpu_boot_description: Configure emulator startup and loading screen behaviors.
gpu_quick_boot_description: Resume instantly from your last saved state (turn off for full cold boot every time).
gpu_tweaks_description: Disable unused emulator hardware modules to speed up launch times and reduce host CPU/RAM usage.
gpu_registry_description: Force Windows Graphics settings to bind the emulator executables directly to your dedicated or integrated GPU.
gpu_registry_path: Writes to {{path}}. This is equivalent to Windows Settings → Display → Graphics Settings.
log_sdk_images_fetched: Fetched {{total}} system images from Google repositories.

log_avd_speed_enabled: Speed Mode applied to "{{name}}": GPU composition forced.
